exportDescription: Download the validated printable model in the format that fits your workflow.
exportStlDescription: One printable mesh for slicers and broad compatibility.
export3mfSeparateDescription: Keep structural letters and raised caps as separate colored objects.
export3mfMergedDescription: Combine all printable shells into one 3MF object.
title: Your name, in 3D.
name: Name
fontFallback: {font} does not include Cyrillic, so {replacement} was selected.
fontArticulatedFallback: {font} is not suitable for articulated letters, so {replacement} was selected.
errorEmptyText: Enter a name to create your keychain.
errorTooLong: Shorten the name to 24 characters or fewer.
errorFontLoad: Could not load the selected font.
errorMissingGlyph: The selected font does not contain “{glyph}”.
errorArticulatedFont: Choose a supported heavy font for articulated letters.
errorEmptyOutline: This name does not produce a usable outline.
errorTooWide: This name cannot fit within 120 mm at the minimum 12 mm text height.
errorDisconnected: Some parts of the name are not connected. Increase padding or choose another style.
errorReliefOutsideBacking: The raised text extends beyond its foundation. Choose another style or adjust the name.
errorNameplateTextOutside: The tilted inscription extends beyond the nameplate. Increase padding or reduce the tilt.
errorNameplateEmbedding: The inscription could not be embedded while leaving a visible raised cap.
errorNotReady: The finished geometry could not be validated. Try a shorter name or another style.
warningScaled: The name was adjusted to {height} mm high to keep the finished keychain within 120 mm.
warningDense: This curved model exceeds 12,000 triangles and may take longer to slice.
warningShallow: A slightly taller text relief is easier to see after printing.
warningArticulatedBaseAdjusted: Base thickness was adjusted to retain printable captive joints.
errorArticulatedJoint: The articulated joint could not be validated. Try a shorter name or increase the joint clearance.
